d: After a woman (Nicole de Boer) locates her birth mother (Barbara Niven), she investigates the older woman's mysterious past.
Convicted of murder, Sarah Pender (Jenna Dewan Tatum) escapes from prison and becomes a most-wanted fugitive.
A beautiful woman (Brooke Burns) hatches a plot to destroy the life of a successful restaurateur (Tim Rozon) and family man.
A charming but devious man (Aiden Turner) conspires to bilk a wealthy veterinarian (Ashley Scott) of her money.
